name: UserVoiceShow
description: Shows an indicator when a user is in a Voice Channel
summary: A speaker next to people in voice; click to open their channel, double-click to join

settings.label: Show in user profiles
settings.description: Show a user's Voice Channel indicator in their profile next to the name

settings.label: Show in member list
settings.description: Show a user's Voice Channel indicator in the member and DMs list

settings.label: Show in messages
settings.description: Show a user's Voice Channel indicator in messages

notes: A speaker after names of people in voice (locked when you can't see or join the channel, deafened or muted icons otherwise), with a tooltip naming the channel and who is in it. Click opens the channel; double click joins it. Channels you can't see are skipped unless ShowHiddenChannels is on.
gaps: The tooltip lists names rather than upstream's row of avatars.
Upstream also puts the indicator among the Friends list's row buttons; Qord's Friends page doesn't show it yet.
